everyday-green-salad.name: Everyday Green Salad
everyday-green-salad.description: Crisp leaves, juicy tomatoes, and a bright lemon dressing. A simple side for almost any table.
ingredients: 100 g butterhead lettuce, washed and dried
steps: Tear the lettuce into bite-size pieces and put it in a large bowl.
Add the tomatoes, cucumber, radishes, and avocado.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, and pepper in a small bowl.
Pour the dressing over the salad. Toss gently and serve straight away.
everyday-green-salad.tip: Keep the leaves and dressing separate until you are ready to eat. Add cooked chickpeas or another protein of your choice for a more substantial meal.

spinach-apple-smoothie.name: Spinach & Apple Smoothie
spinach-apple-smoothie.description: A fresh green blend with apple, banana, and a squeeze of lemon. No complicated ingredients.
steps: Put the water and spinach in a blender. Blend until the leaves are finely broken down.
Add the banana, apple, lemon juice, and ice, if using.
Blend until smooth. Add a little more water if you prefer a thinner drink.
Divide between two glasses and serve immediately.
spinach-apple-smoothie.tip: Use a ripe banana for sweetness. This is a serving idea, not a meal-replacement or detox drink.

roasted-vegetable-bowl.name: Roasted Vegetable Bowl
roasted-vegetable-bowl.description: Colourful roasted vegetables and chickpeas over brown rice. Warm, simple, and easy to make your own.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Line a large baking tray.
Toss the pepper, courgette, broccoli, tomatoes, and chickpeas with the oil and cumin. Spread them in a single layer.
Roast for 20–25 minutes, turning once, until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned.
Heat the cooked rice according to its pack instructions. Divide it between two bowls.
Add the roasted vegetables and chickpeas. Finish with lemon juice and parsley.
roasted-vegetable-bowl.tip: Use a large tray so the vegetables roast evenly. Use freshly cooked rice or follow the storage and reheating instructions on the rice pack.

fresh-basil-pasta.name: Fresh Basil Pasta
fresh-basil-pasta.description: Basil, lemon, and pumpkin seeds make a lively pesto for a quick bowl of tomato pasta.
ingredients: 30 g fresh basil leaves, washed and dried
steps: Cook the spaghetti in boiling water according to its pack instructions. Save a mug of the cooking water before draining.
Blend the basil, pumpkin seeds, garlic, olive oil, and lemon juice into a coarse pesto.
Put the warm pasta back in the pan, off the heat. Add the pesto and tomatoes.
Toss with a splash of the reserved cooking water until the sauce coats the pasta. Add pepper and serve.
fresh-basil-pasta.tip: Keep a few basil leaves to scatter over the bowl. Check the pasta label for allergens and use a suitable alternative if needed.

rocket-pear-and-walnut-salad.name: Rocket Pear and Walnut Salad
rocket-pear-and-walnut-salad.description: Peppery rocket, ripe pear and crunchy walnuts.
steps: Wash and dry the fresh produce. Prepare the salad ingredients as listed.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, cumin, salt and pepper in a small bowl.
Put the prepared salad ingredients in a serving bowl.
Add the dressing, toss gently and serve immediately.
rocket-pear-and-walnut-salad.tip: Dress just before serving to keep the vegetables crisp.

quinoa-spinach-chickpea-salad.name: Quinoa Spinach Chickpea Salad
quinoa-spinach-chickpea-salad.description: A grain salad with spinach chickpea.
steps: Rinse the quinoa in a fine sieve. Put it in a saucepan with the water and salt.
Bring to a boil, cover and simmer gently for 12–15 minutes, or until the water is absorbed. Rest off the heat for 5 minutes.
Fold the spinach and chickpeas into the warm quinoa so the leaves soften slightly.
Mix in the olive oil and lemon juice. Divide between two bowls.
quinoa-spinach-chickpea-salad.tip: Follow the quinoa pack if its water ratio differs. Serve promptly.

carrot-ginger-soup.name: Carrot Ginger Soup
carrot-ginger-soup.description: A smooth vegetable soup for two.
steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan. Cook the onion for 5 minutes over medium heat, stirring, until softened.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Pour in the stock.
Add the carrots and ginger. Simmer for 20 minutes until the carrots are soft.
Remove from the heat. Blend with an immersion blender, keeping the blade submerged. Season with pepper and serve.
carrot-ginger-soup.tip: If using a jug blender, let the soup cool and follow its hot-liquid instructions.

bok-choy-noodle-broth.name: Bok Choy Noodle Broth
bok-choy-noodle-broth.description: Vegetables, tofu and noodles in a light broth.
steps: Bring the stock to a gentle boil in a saucepan.
Add the prepared vegetables and tofu. Simmer for 6–8 minutes until the vegetables are tender and the tofu is hot.
Prepare the rice noodles according to the pack instructions. Drain and divide between two bowls.
Stir the sesame oil and soy sauce into the broth. Ladle the broth, tofu and vegetables over the noodles.
bok-choy-noodle-broth.tip: Use quick-cooking rice noodles. Check the soy sauce label if avoiding wheat.

Whisk the yoghurt, cumin and salt until smooth.
Fold the prepared vegetables and herbs into the yoghurt.
Serve cold as a side dish. Refrigerate promptly if not serving at once.

spinach-garlic-spaghetti.name: Spinach Garlic Spaghetti
spinach-garlic-spaghetti.description: A quick pan sauce tossed through warm pasta.
steps: Cook the pasta in boiling water according to the pack. Save 150 ml cooking water before draining.
While the pasta cooks, heat the oil in a large frying pan. Cook the garlic over medium-low heat for 30 seconds without browning.
Add the spinach and stir for 2–3 minutes until wilted.
Add the drained pasta, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Toss with enough reserved water to coat, then serve.
spinach-garlic-spaghetti.tip: Cook the sauce while the pasta boils. Add pasta water a spoonful at a time.

While the pasta cooks, heat the oil in a large frying pan. Cook the garlic over medium-low heat for 30 seconds without browning.
Add the tomatoes and oregano. Cook for 8 minutes, pressing a few tomatoes to make a sauce.
Add the drained pasta, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Toss with enough reserved water to coat, then serve.
tomato-oregano-penne.tip: Cook the sauce while the pasta boils. Add pasta water a spoonful at a time.

zucchini-lemon-pasta.tip: Cook the sauce while the pasta boils. Add pasta water a spoonful at a time.

kale-chilli-pasta.description: A quick pan sauce tossed through warm pasta.
ingredients: 120 g curly kale, stems removed and leaves chopped
steps: Cook the pasta in boiling water according to the pack. Save 150 ml cooking water before draining.
While the pasta cooks, heat the oil in a large frying pan. Cook the garlic over medium-low heat for 30 seconds without browning.
Add the kale, chilli flakes and 3 tbsp pasta water. Cover for 5 minutes, then uncover and stir until tender.
Add the drained pasta, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Toss with enough reserved water to coat, then serve.
kale-chilli-pasta.tip: Cook the sauce while the pasta boils. Add pasta water a spoonful at a time.

mushroom-parsley-pasta.description: A quick pan sauce tossed through warm pasta.
steps: Cook the pasta in boiling water according to the pack. Save 150 ml cooking water before draining.
While the pasta cooks, heat the oil in a large frying pan. Cook the garlic over medium-low heat for 30 seconds without browning.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 8 minutes until golden. Stir in the parsley.
Add the drained pasta, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Toss with enough reserved water to coat, then serve.
mushroom-parsley-pasta.tip: Cook the sauce while the pasta boils. Add pasta water a spoonful at a time.

pea-mint-pasta.name: Pea Mint Pasta
pea-mint-pasta.description: A quick pan sauce tossed through warm pasta.
steps: Cook the pasta in boiling water according to the pack. Save 150 ml cooking water before draining.
While the pasta cooks, heat the oil in a large frying pan. Cook the garlic over medium-low heat for 30 seconds without browning.
Add the peas and 3 tbsp pasta water. Simmer for 4–5 minutes until hot, then stir in the mint.
Add the drained pasta, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Toss with enough reserved water to coat, then serve.
pea-mint-pasta.tip: Cook the sauce while the pasta boils. Add pasta water a spoonful at a time.

sesame-bok-choy.name: Sesame Bok Choy
sesame-bok-choy.description: A simple vegetable side with garlic and sesame.
ingredients: 300 g bok choy, stems and leaves separated
steps: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and stir for 20 seconds.
Stir-fry the stems for 4 minutes. Add the leaves and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the soy sauce and sesame seeds. Cook for 30 seconds and serve hot.
sesame-bok-choy.tip: Serve as a side with cooked rice or noodles.

ingredients: 300 g green beans, trimmed and halved

Add the garlic and stir for 20 seconds.
Add the beans and 60 ml water. Cover and cook for 8–10 minutes until tender, then uncover.
Stir in the soy sauce and sesame seeds. Cook for 30 seconds and serve hot.
garlic-green-beans.tip: Serve as a side with cooked rice or noodles.

cumin-carrot-chickpea-tray.name: Cumin Carrot Chickpea Tray
cumin-carrot-chickpea-tray.description: Roasted vegetables and chickpeas on one tray.
ingredients: 300 g carrots, cut into 1 cm pieces
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Line a large baking tray.
Toss the vegetables, chickpeas, oil, cumin, salt and any listed herbs together. Spread in a single layer.
Roast for 30–35 minutes, turning halfway, until the vegetables are tender. Test the largest piece with a fork; cook a little longer if needed.
Drizzle with the lemon juice and divide between two plates.
cumin-carrot-chickpea-tray.tip: Leave space between pieces. A crowded tray can steam rather than roast.

spinach-besan-chilla.name: Spinach Besan Chilla
spinach-besan-chilla.description: Savoury chickpea flour pancakes with fresh vegetables.
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour, water, cumin and salt into a smooth batter. Rest for 5 minutes.
Stir in the prepared vegetables and herbs. Add a spoonful of water if the batter does not spread.
Brush a non-stick pan with a little oil over medium heat. Spread one quarter of the batter into a thin pancake.
Cook for 2–3 minutes per side until set, golden and cooked through with no wet batter. Repeat to make four pancakes.
spinach-besan-chilla.tip: Use a thin layer of batter so the centre cooks before the outside browns.

spinach-pea-rice.name: Spinach Pea Rice
spinach-pea-rice.description: A one-pan rice dish with vegetables and herbs.
steps: Rinse and drain the rice. Heat the oil in a saucepan and cook the onion and cumin for 5 minutes until the onion is soft.
Add the drained rice and stir for 1 minute. Stir in the peas with the rice. Add the spinach for the final 3 minutes of cooking.
Add the water and salt. Bring to a boil, cover and cook on low heat for 12–15 minutes until the rice is tender and the water absorbed.
Remove from the heat and rest, covered, for 5 minutes. Add any finishing ingredients noted above, fluff with a fork and serve.
spinach-pea-rice.tip: Follow the rice pack if its water ratio differs. Serve freshly cooked.

Blend until smooth. Add a little more drinking water if too thick.
Divide between two glasses and serve immediately.
mint-mango-lassi.tip: Use plain unsweetened yoghurt. This makes two small servings.

spinach-red-lentil-dal.name: Spinach Red Lentil Dal
spinach-red-lentil-dal.description: Soft red lentils with vegetables and a cumin base.
steps: Rinse and drain the lentils. Heat the oil in a saucepan. Cook the onion and cumin for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and turmeric. Stir for 30 seconds. Add the lentils and water. Add the spinach for the final 3 minutes.
Bring to a boil, then simmer gently for 18–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils break down. Add a splash of water if needed.
Add the salt and any finishing ingredients noted above. Stir and serve in two bowls.
spinach-red-lentil-dal.tip: Use split red lentils; whole lentils need a different cooking time.
